event.eyebrow: 安靜閱讀活動・第一場籌備中
event.lede: 帶一本你正在讀的書來。在有音樂、有咖啡的地方，和一群也喜歡讀書的人，一起讀一段，再聊一聊。

details.label: 地點（暫定）
details.value: 台北的共享空間​或咖啡館

about.title: 帶你自己的書
about.body: 小說、哲學、漫畫、電子書都可以。不用事先讀任何指定的書，也不用讀完。

about.title: 大部分時間是安靜的
about.body: 手機收起來，在背景音樂裡讀自己的書。一個人來也完全沒問題。

about.title: 中間和最後，聊一聊
about.body: 跟身邊的人說說你在讀什麼、哪一段留在心上。想只聽不說，也可以。

event.flowNote: 時間為暫定，實際依場地調整。

flow.title: 入場
flow.body: 找個位子，點杯喝的，把手機調成靜音收起來。

flow.title: 開場
flow.body: 幾分鐘的呼吸，讓自己從一整天裡慢下來。

flow.title: 第一段閱讀
flow.body: 四十五分鐘，安靜地讀，背景放著音樂。

flow.title: 中場聊天
flow.body: 抽一張問題卡，和旁邊的人一對一聊十幾分鐘。

flow.title: 第二段閱讀
flow.body: 再讀四十分鐘。剛才聊到的，也許會讀出不一樣的東西。

flow.title: 小組分享
flow.body: 三五個人一組，說說今天讀了什麼、哪一句想帶回家。

flow.title: 散場
flow.body: 可以直接走，也可以留下來繼續聊。

bring: 一本正在讀的書（紙本或電子書）
一點想安靜下來的心情
如果想記下什麼，一支筆

faq.q: 我讀書速度很慢，或很久沒讀書了，可以來嗎？
faq.a: 當然可以。這裡沒有進度，閱讀一頁也是閱讀。

faq.q: 一定要跟其他人分享嗎？
faq.a: 完全不用！聊天的時段只想聽他人分享，也完全沒關係。
還沒決定，可能會包含一杯飲料或場地費。確定後公布在這頁。

event.eyebrow: Quiet reading event · First one in the works
event.lede: Bring whatever you're reading. Somewhere with music and coffee, with a room of people who also like to read — read for a while together, then talk about it.

details.label: Where (TBC)
details.value: A coworking space or café in Taipei

about.title: Bring your own book
about.body: Novels, philosophy, comics, e-books — anything. Nothing to read beforehand, nothing to finish.

about.title: Mostly quiet
about.body: Phones away, your own book, music in the background. Coming alone is completely fine.

about.title: Talk in the middle and at the end
about.body: Tell someone what you're reading and what stayed with you. Just listening is fine too.

event.flowNote: Times are tentative and may shift with the venue.

flow.title: Arrive
flow.body: Find a seat, get a drink, put your phone on silent and away.

flow.title: Settle in
flow.body: A few minutes of breathing to slow down from the day.

flow.title: First reading
flow.body: Forty-five minutes of quiet reading, with music on.

flow.title: Halftime chat
flow.body: Draw a question card and talk one-on-one with the person next to you.

flow.title: Second reading
flow.body: Forty more minutes. What you just talked about might change how it reads.

flow.title: Small groups
flow.body: Groups of three to five: what you read today, and a line you'd take home.

flow.title: Wrap up
flow.body: Head off, or stay and keep talking.

bring: A book you're reading (paper or e-book)
A mind ready to slow down
A pen, if you like to note things

faq.q: I read slowly, or haven't read in ages. Can I come?
faq.a: Of course. There's no pace here — reading one page is still reading.

faq.q: Do I have to share with others?
faq.a: Not at all! If you'd rather just listen to others during the chats, that's completely fine.
